name: add_content_labels
description:
Adds labels to a content item. If the content does not have existing labels,
a new entry is created. Returns the updated list of labels.

id.description: The ID of the content to add labels to. Must be a non-empty string.

labels.description: List of labels to add. Must contain at least one label. All elements must be strings.

name: convert_content_body
description: Converts a content body from one format to another.

to.description:
The target format to convert to. Valid values are:- "view": For viewing the content. Strips 'ac:' namespace prefix from Docfluence macro tags (e.g., → ). Handles both regular and self-closing tags.- "export_view": For exporting the content. Transforms ac: tags to div elements with class names (e.g., →
). Self-closing tags like are converted to properly closed divs (
).- "editor": For editing the content. Wraps content in editor-specific markup.- "storage": For storing the content. Ensures proper Docfluence storage format markup.

body.description: The content body to convert, containing: type (str) - The current content format type; value (str) - The actual content value.

name: create_content
description:
Creates new content.

This function creates a new content item (page, blogpost, and comment) with the specified
details and stores it in the database. It handles both basic content creation and special
cases like comments with ancestor relationships.

body.description: The complete specification for the new content item to be created. Required fields: type (str): Content type, must be one of page, blogpost, comment. title (str): Content title, must be a non-empty string. spaceKey (str): Space key where content will be created, must be a non-empty string and exist in database. Optional fields: status (str): Content status, defaults to current. body (Dict): Content body with storage format. createdBy (str): Username of creator, defaults to unknown. postingDay (str): Posting day for blogposts in YYYY-MM-DD format, required for blogpost type. ancestors (List[str]): List of ancestor content IDs, must be non-empty for comment type. The structure must conform to ContentInput validation.

type.description: Content type. Must be one of: 'page', 'blogpost', 'comment'

title.description: Content title. Must be a non-empty string.

spaceKey.description: Space key where content will be created. Must be a non-empty string and must exist in the database.

status.description: Content status. Must be one of: 'current', 'draft', 'archived', 'trashed'. Defaults to 'current' if not provided.

body.description: Content body with storage format. Contains storage object with required value property (str): The content value in storage format, and optional representation property (str): The representation type, defaults to storage if not provided. Defaults to empty storage if body is not provided.

storage.description: Storage format object containing the content's value and representation type. Required property: value (str): The content value in storage format. Optional property: representation (Optional[str]): The representation type (e.g., storage, view), defaults to storage if not provided, can be null when not explicitly set.

value.description: The content value in storage format.

representation.description: The representation type (Allowed values: "storage", "view", "editor", "export_view", "styled_view"). When the storage object is provided but representation is omitted, it defaults to "storage". This field is optional within the storage object.

createdBy.description: Username of the content creator. Defaults to "unknown" if not provided.

postingDay.description: Posting day for blog posts in "YYYY-MM-DD" format (e.g., "2024-01-15"). Required when type is "blogpost". Must not be a future date. For other content types (page, comment), this field is ignored if provided.

ancestors.description: List of ancestor content IDs (strings). Required (must be a non-empty list) when type is 'comment'.

name: create_content_attachments
description: Adds an attachment to a piece of content.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parent content to add the attachment to.

file.description: The relative location and name of the attachment file to be added to the content.

minorEdit.description: If set to true, no notification email or activity stream will be generated when the attachment is added.

comment.description: The comment for the attachment that is being added. Defaults to None.

status.description: The status of the attachment being added. Valid values: current, draft, archived, trashed. Defaults to "current".

name: create_content_property
description: Creates a new property for a specified content item.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content

body.description: A dictionary representing the new content property to be created for the content item.

key.description: The property key (must be unique for this content)

value.description: The property value. Can be any JSON type.

name: create_content_property_for_key
description: Creates a new content property for a specified key.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content

value.description: The property value. Can be any JSON type.

name: create_private_space
description:
Creates a new private space.

This function behaves identically to create_space and returns a new private space dictionary.

body.description: The properties required to create a new private space.

key.description: The unique identifier for the space. Must be composed of only alphanumeric characters (A-Z, 0-9) and no more than 255 characters in length.

name.description: The display name of the space.

description.description: An optional description of the space. Defaults to empty string.

name: create_space
description: Creates and returns a new space dictionary from the provided data.

body.description: A dictionary representing the properties for the new space. Required fields: name (str) - The display name of the space; key (str) - The key for the space, must be alphanumeric (A-Z, 0-9) and no more than 255 characters. Optional fields: description (str) - The description of the space, defaults to empty string.

name.description: The display name of the space.

key.description: The key for the space. Must be composed of only alphanumeric characters (A-Z, 0-9) and no more than 255 characters in length. Stored as uppercase.

description.description: The description of the space. Defaults to empty string.

name: delete_content
description:
Deletes a content item from the system.

This function trashes or purges content based on its ContentType and ContentStatus,
following the official Docfluence API behavior:

**Three Cases:**

1. **Trashable content with status "current"**:
- Content is trashed (soft delete)
- Status changed from "current" to "trashed"
- Content remains in database
- All descendant content (comments, attachments, child pages) is also trashed

2. **Trashable content with status "trashed" + status parameter "trashed"**:
- Content is purged (permanently deleted)
- All associated data cascade deleted (properties, labels, history)

3. **Non-trashable content (draft, archived)**:
- Content is deleted permanently without being trashed
- All associated data cascade deleted

**Trashable vs Non-trashable:**
- Trashable: Content with status "current" or "trashed"
- Non-trashable: Content with status "draft" or "archived"

id.description: The unique identifier of the content to delete. Must be a numeric string representing a valid content ID in the system (e.g., "1", "42", "12345").

status.description: Optional query parameter that controls deletion behavior. Must be set to "trashed" if provided to permanently delete already-trashed content. If not provided, the deletion behavior depends on the current status of the content. Defaults to None if not provided.

name: delete_content_labels
description:
Deletes labels from a content item. If a specific label is provided,
only that label is deleted. Otherwise, all labels are deleted.

id.description: The ID of the content from which labels should be deleted. Must be a non-empty string.

label.description: Optional specific label to delete. If not provided, all labels for the content are deleted. Defaults to None.

name: delete_content_property
description: Deletes a property from a content item identified by its key.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content. This must be a non-empty string that matches an existing content ID in the database.

key.description: The key of the property to delete. This must be a non-empty string that identifies a specific property associated with the content item.

name: delete_space
description:
Deletes a space and all associated content, tracking the deletion task.

Deletes the space identified by spaceKey, along with all content items in that space, and returns a task dictionary that tracks the deletion process.
Note: The deletion task is marked as complete immediately.

spaceKey.description: The unique identifier of the space to delete. Must be non-empty.

name: get_content_attachments
description: Returns attachments for a specific content item with optional filtering and pagination.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parent content.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of attachments to return. Defaults to 50.

filename.description: Filter attachments by filename. Defaults to None.

mediaType.description: Filter attachments by media type. Defaults to None.

name: get_content_children
description:
Returns a mapping of direct children content grouped by type.

This function retrieves all direct children of a content item by searching for content
that has the specified item as their immediate parent (ancestor). Results are grouped
by content type (page, blogpost, comment, attachment) for easy access.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent content item. Must be a non-empty string. Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

expand.description: A comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response for each child content item. Valid fields: 'space' (expands space information), 'version' (expands version details), 'history' (expands content history), 'body' (includes content body), 'metadata' (includes additional metadata). Multiple fields can be requested (e.g., 'space,version'). If None or empty, children are returned with only base fields. Defaults to None.

parentVersion.description: The version number of the parent content to consider for version-specific child queries. Must be non-negative. A value of 0 returns all children (default behavior). When set to N > 0, returns only children that were created before or during the time when the parent was at version N. The filtering uses timestamp-based estimation, assuming versions are spread evenly across the parent's lifetime. Defaults to 0.

name: get_content_children_by_type
description:
Returns direct children content of a specified type.

This function retrieves all direct children of a content item by searching for content
that has the specified item as their immediate parent (last in ancestors array). Results are
filtered by type and support pagination.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent content. Must be a non-empty string.

child_type.description: The type of child content to retrieve. Must be one of: 'page', 'blogpost', 'comment', 'attachment'. Must be a non-empty string.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of child content items to return (1-1000). Must be between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 25.

name: get_content_comments
description:
Returns the comments associated with a specific content item.

This function retrieves all comments that have the specified content as their immediate parent
(ancestor). Comments are stored as separate content items with an 'ancestors' field pointing to
their parent content. The function supports pagination and optional field expansion.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parent content. Must be a non-empty string. Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

expand.description:
A comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the
returned comment objects (e.g., 'space', 'metadata.labels'). If provided, must not be empty or whitespace-only. Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

parentVersion.description: The version of the parent content. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0. When set to 0, returns all comments. When set to N > 0, returns comments that existed at parent version N.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of comment objects to return (1-1000). Must be between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 25.

name: get_content_descendants
description:
Returns all descendants of a content item, grouped by type.

This function retrieves all descendant content items (children, grandchildren, etc.) of a specified
parent content item. Descendants are collected recursively and grouped by their content type (page,
blogpost, comment, attachment). The results support pagination applied to each content type list.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent content. Must be a non-empty string.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of descendant items to return per type. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 25.

name: get_content_descendants_by_type
description:
Returns descendants of a specific type for a content item.

This function retrieves all descendant content items (children, grandchildren, etc.) of a specified type
from a parent content item. Descendants are collected recursively and filtered by the specified content
type. The results support pagination.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent content. Must be a non-empty string.

type.description: The type of descendant content to retrieve. Must be one of: 'page', 'blogpost', 'comment', 'attachment'.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of descendant items to return. Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 25.

name: get_content_details
description:
Retrieves content by its unique identifier.

This function fetches a content item from the database using its ID. It can optionally
filter the content by its status to ensure the content matches the expected state.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content to retrieve. Must be a numeric string representing a valid content ID in the system (e.g., '1', '42', '12345'). Whitespace will be automatically trimmed.

status.description: Optional status filter to verify the content matches the expected state. Valid values are 'current' (published content), 'draft' (unpublished work in progress), 'archived' (no longer active but retained), 'trashed' (marked for deletion), or 'any' (bypass status check). Defaults to None if not provided.

name: get_content_history
description:
Returns the history of a piece of content.

This method returns the metadata regarding creation and versioning for the content item
identified by the given id. It uses a global history store (DB["history"]) that is updated
whenever content is created or updated. Each history record includes the version number,
createdBy, createdDate, and lastUpdated timestamp.

id.description: Unique identifier of the content.

expand.description:
A comma-separated list of additional fields to expand
(e.g., "previousVersion,nextVersion,lastUpdated"). Defaults to None if not provided.

name: get_content_labels
description:
Returns a paginated list of content labels. If a prefix is provided,
it filters labels that start with the given prefix.

id.description: The ID of the content to get labels for. Must be a non-empty string.

prefix.description: Optional prefix to filter labels by. If provided, only labels starting with this prefix are returned. Defaults to None.

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of labels to return (1-1000). Must be between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 200.

name: get_content_list
description:
Returns a paginated list of content filtered by the specified parameters.

This function retrieves content from the database and applies filters based on the provided
arguments (type, spaceKey, title, status, postingDay). The results are paginated using start
and limit parameters. Additional fields can be expanded using the expand parameter.

The function supports filtering by content type, space location, title, status, and posting
date (for blog posts only). Results can be expanded to include space details, version
information, and history metadata.

type.description: The type of content to filter by. Valid values: 'page' (standard wiki page), 'blogpost' (blog entry), 'comment' (user comment), 'attachment' (file attachment). If None, no type filtering is applied and content of all types is returned. Defaults to None.

spaceKey.description: The key identifier of the Docfluence space to filter content by. Only content within the specified space will be returned. Must be a non-empty, non-whitespace-only string if provided. If None, no space filtering is applied. Defaults to None.

title.description: The optional exact title of the content to filter by. If None or empty, no title filtering is applied. Defaults to None.

status.description: The status of content to filter by. Valid values: 'current' (published/active content), 'trashed' (deleted but not permanently removed), 'any' (all statuses, no filtering). If None, behaves the same as 'current'. Defaults to 'current'.

postingDay.description: The posting date for blog posts in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-15'). This filter is only applied when type='blogpost' and is ignored for other content types. Must match the exact posting date of blog posts. If None, no posting date filtering is applied. Defaults to None.

expand.description: A comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response for each content item. Valid fields: 'space', 'version', 'history', and 'body.storage'. Multiple fields can be requested (e.g., 'space,version'). If None or empty, no expansion is performed. Defaults to None.

start.description: The zero-based starting index for pagination. Determines which content item to start returning from the filtered result set. Must be non-negative. For example, start=0 returns from the first item, start=10 skips the first 10 items. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of content items to return per page. Must be non-negative. Set to 0 to return no results (useful for count-only queries). For example, limit=25 returns up to 25 items. Defaults to 25.

name: get_content_properties
description: Returns a paginated list of content properties for the specified content.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content

start.description: The starting index for pagination. Defaults to 0. Must be non-negative

limit.description: The maximum number of properties to return (1-1000). Defaults to 10. Must be between 1 and 1000.

name: get_content_property_details
description: Retrieves a specific property of a content item by its key.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content item. This must be a non-empty string that matches an existing content ID in the database.

key.description: The key of the property to retrieve. This must be a non-empty string that identifies a specific property associated with the content item.

name: get_content_restrictions_by_operation
description:
Retrieves all restrictions for a content item, grouped by operation type.

This function returns restriction information for read and update operations on the specified
content. Each operation includes user and group restrictions.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content. Must be a non-empty string. Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

name: get_content_restrictions_for_operation
description:
Retrieves restrictions for a specific operation on a content item.

This function returns restriction information for a single operation type (read or update)
on the specified content. The operation includes user and group restrictions with pagination
support.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content. Must be a non-empty string. Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

operationKey.description: The operation type. Must be either "read" or "update". Whitespace is automatically trimmed.

start.description: The starting index for pagination of restriction results. Must be non-negative. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of restriction results to return per collection (users and groups) (1-1000). Must be between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 100.

name: get_long_task_details
description:
Returns a specific long-running task by its ID.

Retrieves the long-running task dictionary that matches the provided task ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the task.

name: get_long_tasks
description: Returns a paginated list of all long-running tasks. Retrieves a list of task dictionaries for all long-running tasks.

start.description:
The starting index for pagination. Must be >= 0.
Defaults to 0.

limit.description:
The maximum number of tasks to return (1-1000). Must be between 1 and 1000.
Defaults to 100.

name: get_space_content
description:
Retrieves the content within a specific space (current or draft).

Returns a list of content item dictionaries for the space identified by spaceKey.

spaceKey.description: The unique identifier of the space. Must be a non-empty string.

start.description:
The starting index for pagination.
Defaults to 0. Must be a non-negative integer.

limit.description:
The maximum number of content items to return (1-1000).
Defaults to 25. Must be between 1 and 1000.

name: get_space_content_by_type
description:
Retrieves content of a specific type within a space (current or draft).

Returns a list of content item dictionaries matching the specified type for the given spaceKey.
Note: The function first retrieves all content for the space and then filters by type.

spaceKey.description: The unique identifier of the space. Must be non-empty.

type.description: The type of content to filter. Valid values: page, blogpost, comment, attachment. Must be non-empty.

start.description:
The starting index for pagination after filtering.
Defaults to 0. Must be non-negative.

limit.description:
The maximum number of content items to return after filtering (1-1000).
Defaults to 25. Must be between 1 and 1000.

name: get_space_details
description:
Retrieves details about a specific space.

Returns the space dictionary for the provided spaceKey.

spaceKey.description: The unique identifier of the space.

name: get_spaces
description: Returns a paginated list of spaces. If spaceKey is provided (single key or comma-separated keys), returns only the specified space(s); otherwise returns all spaces.

spaceKey.description:
A unique identifier or comma-separated identifiers to filter spaces by.
Must be a non-empty string if provided. Defaults to None.

start.description:
The starting index for pagination.
Defaults to 0. Must be non-negative.

limit.description:
The maximum number of spaces to return (1-1000).
Defaults to 25. Must be between 1 and 1000.

name: search_content
description:
Search for content based on a CQL (Docfluence Query Language) query.

This function performs a comprehensive search across all content items using the provided CQL query.
It supports complex queries with logical operators, field comparisons, and returns paginated results
with optional field expansion.

query.description:
The CQL query string. Supported syntax:
- Field operators: = (equals), != (not equals), ~ (contains), !~ (does not contain),
  >, <, >=, <= (numeric/date comparison)
- Logical operators: AND, OR, NOT (case-insensitive)
- Grouping: Use parentheses () for complex expressions
- Value types: Strings ('value' or "value"), Numbers (123 or 45.67), Keywords (null, true, false), Functions (now())
- Supported fields: type, space, spaceKey, title, status, id, text, created, postingDay, label
- Field mappings:
    * type: Content type ('page', 'blogpost', 'comment', 'attachment')
    * space/spaceKey: The key of the space containing this content
    * title: The title/name of the content item
    * status: Content status
    * id: Unique identifier for the content item
    * text: Master field that searches across title, content body, and labels (supports ~ and !~ operators)
    * created: Maps to history.createdDate (supports date comparison operators)
    * postingDay: Direct field on blogpost content (YYYY-MM-DD format, supports date comparison)
    * label: Searches content labels directly (supports =, !=, ~, !~ operators)
    - Examples:
      * "type='page' AND spaceKey='DOC'"
      * "type='page' AND space='DOC'"
      * "title~'meeting' OR title~'notes'"
      * "status='current' AND NOT type='comment'"
      * "text~'marketing' AND type='page'"
      * "created>='2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'"
      * "type='blogpost' AND postingDay>='2024-01-01'"
      * "label='finished' AND type='page'"
      * "label!='draft' OR type='blogpost'"
      * "id = 1" (unquoted number)
      * "postingDay = null" (null keyword for fields without values)
      * "postingDay != null" (fields that have values)
- CQL Functions:
  * now(): Current timestamp
  * now("-4w"): 4 weeks ago
  * now("+1d"): 1 day from now
  * Supported units: d/day, w/week, M/month, y/year, h/hour, m/min/minute
- Function Examples:
  * "created > now('-4w')" - Content created in last 4 weeks
  * "title~'project launch' and created > now('-4w')" - Project launch content from last 4 weeks
- Note: space field is used for CQL queries, expand='space' returns structured objects

expand.description:
Comma-separated list of properties to expand in results.
Supported values:
- space: Add detailed space information object with 'spaceKey', 'name', 'description' fields
- version: Enhance existing version object by adding 'when' (timestamp) and 'by' (user object) fields
- body: Ensure content body has proper storage structure (may affect pagination limits)
- body.storage: Ensure storage representation has proper structure with 'value' and 'representation' fields
- body.view: Add view representation of body (converted from storage) with 'value' and 'representation' fields
- metadata: Add metadata object with 'labels' and 'properties' sub-objects
- metadata.labels: Add metadata object with only 'labels' sub-object
- history: No effect (history is already included in base response)
- ancestors: Enhance existing ancestors array by adding full details (type, title, status, space, links) to each ancestor
- container: Add container object (same structure as space field)

start.description: Starting index for pagination (default: 0, must be non-negative)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, range: 1-1000)

name: update_attachment_data
description:
Updates the file content of an existing attachment.

This function replaces the file data of an existing attachment with new file data. The attachment
must exist and be associated with the specified parent content. The version number is incremented
and metadata is updated. Input validation is performed using Pydantic models.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parent content containing the attachment. Must be a non-empty string.

attachmentId.description: The unique identifier of the attachment to update. Must be a non-empty string.

file.description: The file path of the new file to replace the existing attachment data. Must be a non-empty string and the file must exist.

comment.description: An optional comment describing the update. If empty string is provided, the existing comment will be removed. Defaults to None.

minorEdit.description: If set to true, no notification email or activity stream will be generated for this update. Defaults to false.

name: update_attachment_metadata
description:
Updates the metadata of an existing attachment.

This function allows updating various metadata fields of an attachment such as comment, mediaType,
title. The attachment must exist and be associated with the
specified parent content. Input validation is performed using Pydantic models.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parent content that contains the attachment. Must be a non-empty string.

attachmentId.description: The unique identifier of the attachment to update. Must be a non-empty string.

body.description: A dictionary containing the metadata fields to update. Common fields include: comment (str): Attachment comment/description, mediaType (str): MIME type (e.g., "text/plain", "application/pdf"), title (str): New display name for the attachment

comment.description: Attachment comment or description. Defaults to None. The existing comment is removed if empty string is passed.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., "text/plain", "application/pdf", "image/png"). Defaults to None.

title.description: New display name/title for the attachment. Defaults to None.

name: update_content
description:
Updates existing content.

This function updates an existing content item with new values. Versioning is managed
automatically: the version is incremented by one. The update payload should not include
a version object (any provided version data is ignored).

Special behavior:
  - **Restoring a trashed page:** To restore content that is "trashed", the update request
    must set its status to "current". In that case, only the version is incremented and
    the status updated to "current". No other fields are modified.
  - **Publishing a draft:** If the content is a draft, it can only be updated by setting
    status to "current" (publishing it). Updating a draft while keeping it as draft is
    not supported.
  - **Partial body updates:** When updating the body, if only 'value' is provided in
    body.storage, the existing 'representation' is preserved. Both fields can be updated
    by providing both in the request.

id.description: ID of the content to update. Must be a non-empty string.

body.description: A payload with the fields to be updated for the content item. All fields are optional - provide only the fields you need to update. At least one field must be provided. Fields that can be updated: title (str, optional): New content title. Must be a non-empty string if provided. status (str, optional): New content status. Must be one of: current, archived, draft, trashed if provided. body (Dict, optional): New content body object with storage representation containing value (str, required) and representation (str, optional). spaceKey (str, optional): New space key. Must be a non-empty string and must exist in the database if provided. ancestors (List[str], optional): List of ancestor IDs for comments. Each ID must be a non-empty string and must exist.

title.description: New content title. Must be a non-empty string if provided.

status.description: New content status. Must be one of: 'current', 'archived', 'draft', 'trashed' if provided.

body.description: New content body object with storage representation. Contains storage object (required if body is provided) with value property (str, required): Markup content, required if storage is provided, and representation property (str, optional): Markup type (e.g., storage), if not provided the existing representation value is preserved.

storage.description: Storage representation with value (str, required): Markup content, required if storage is provided, and representation (str, optional): Markup type (e.g., storage), if not provided the existing representation value is preserved.

value.description: Markup content. Required if storage is provided.

representation.description: Markup type (e.g., "storage"). If not provided, existing representation is preserved.

spaceKey.description: New space key. Must be a non-empty string and must exist in the database if provided.

ancestors.description: List of ancestor IDs (for comments). Each ID must be a non-empty string and must exist.

name: update_content_property
description: Updates an existing content property with a new value and version.

id.description: The unique identifier of the content

key.description: The key of the property to update

body.description: Property update payload with new property value and version

value.description: The property value. Can be any JSON type.

version.description: Version object with new version number to apply.

number.description: New version number to apply (typically current+1)

name: update_space
description:
Updates an existing space.

Updates and returns a space dictionary for the space specified by spaceKey.
At least one field (name or description) must be provided in body.

spaceKey.description: The unique identifier of the space to update. Must be non-empty.

body.description: A data payload with the new values for the space's attributes. Must contain at least one of: name or description. Fields: name (Optional[str]) - The new display name of the space, must be non-empty string if provided, defaults to None; description (Optional[str]) - The new description of the space, defaults to None.

name.description: The new display name of the space. Must be non-empty string if provided. Defaults to None.

description.description: The new description of the space. Defaults to None.
